response.answer: Tell them you make your best calls when you can externalize the dependency order—especially by drawing the job graph on a whiteboard before acting. Complex incidents are not a problem for you when you have that structure, and your most reliable thinking window is 09:00–12:00. By contrast, very early single-job restart pages are manageable because they need little deliberation; the current paging policy does not offer a written-first alternative for incidents.
